text: The documented meta is the Cherry deck, and your lineup already is it. What separates scores is levels, runes, gear, Brightseeker/Milk stars and retries, not cookie choice.
detail: Same 12 cookies and pets in your screenshot as in the Naver guide and the 1T 312G run.

text: Levels steer Pomegranate's +69% skill-amp beams. Carries sit at the top of the ATK order (Milk › Brightseeker › Skating Queen › Macaron › Tea Knight › Cheesecake), fillers at Lv.1, and Scorpion is held in the 7th slot to catch stray beams.
detail: Order by ATK, not power, and check it in battle: Octo Wasabi adds +8% ATK when Scorpion enters.

text: Rank on damage, not on the 배 multiple. Pomegranate at Lv.1 doesn't add damage; it only lowers power and inflates the multiple.
Runes: Milk all ATK%; Pomegranate, Skating Queen, Macaron, Cheesecake and Tea Knight all skill amp; Brightseeker skill haste to about 40–50 total with gear; Dark Choco haste.
Raid gear preset: weapons skill amp + crit dmg, top-right haste + skill amp, armour damage reduction + HP, bottom-right haste + damage reduction. No move speed, accuracy, focus or crit resistance.

The best documented run is 1T 999G with the plain Cherry deck. The score is on screen, posted by DC user awkward2637, who also posted 섬영's lobby screens; crumb.gg lists the score as 섬영 (판도라). The team power isn't shown, and the author's stated ~650× implies about 3.07G. crumb.gg's Season 5 leaders sit at 2.3–3.2T, and none of them has published a team.
detail: The arithmetic closes most of the gap: about 3G of team power at 650–780× is 2–2.3T. The author gives 21G account power (the top-20 band is 17–26G); in the same thread another player (female8264) reports 780× with the plain Cherry deck and Tiger Lily and expects 3T. The same author went from 893.3G on 9/20 to 1.62T on 9/25 and 2T on 9/26. Power is necessary but not sufficient: 2.38G gave 1.07T at 448×, and 3G gave 1.3T at 450×. The multiple still comes from ATK order, runes and retries.

text: The Season 5 jump from about 1.8T to 3.2T coincides with the first cookies surviving the 17 s wipe. That takes about 9M HP and 45% damage reduction per survivor.
detail: At 21G account power, Macaron, Brightseeker, Pomegranate and Skating Queen survive and deal damage until 8 s left; Milk (열정페이) and the 5M-HP ATK-order cookies still die. Every public run up to 1.6T, and the #1 guild's own 827.6G video, ends at the wipe. This is a timing match, not a shown build.

text: Among the Season 5 top 50, score tracks setup more than raw account power.
detail: Score ÷ account power runs 75–143× (median about 100). The account with the most power (30.0G) placed only #24, and #9 reached 2T 509G on 18.7G. crumb.gg power is account-wide, so these ratios don't compare with the forum's team-power 배.

text: Expect hours of retries. At about 1.7G, 500× lands in 1 of 5 runs and 1T in 1–2 of 10, and records come from overnight macro sessions.
detail: Retries buy little once a setup is near its ceiling: the later 1T 999G author spent two hours of manual retries on 9/19 for a +16G personal best, then left the game on auto. His next record, a day later, followed a build change: haste runes on Tiger Lily (dc:71121).
